bullets.text: 5G SA Launch in Manchester - **Virgin Media O2** activates 5G SA, enhancing connectivity for over 589,000 residents.
Maritime 5G SA Trials - **Ericsson** and Leonardo test 5G SA for naval operations, showcasing secure data exchange.
AI Boosts 5G Emissions Cuts - AI solutions can significantly reduce energy emissions in 5G networks, aiding ESG goals.
Private 5G Network Challenges - Space constraints hinder private 5G deployment, pushing for virtualized architectures.
Trusted Tech Alliance Formed - Major tech firms, including **Google** and **Ericsson**, unite for transparency and security.
Telia's Nationwide 5G SA - **Telia** launches commercial 5G SA in Norway, enhancing critical application support.
Optical Switching for Reliability - **Taara** aims for carrier-grade uptime with new optical switching technology.
6G as Sensing Infrastructure - Future networks may integrate sensing capabilities, transforming connectivity into situational awareness.
Vodafone's Private 5G Insights - **Vodafone Business** reports nearly 200 private 5G deployments, aiming for broader enterprise solutions.
Radcom's Revenue Growth - **RADCOM** reports 17.2% revenue growth, driven by 5G and AI demand.
